The complete experiment, value convergence, and certified optimal attainment are proved only for the separate positive-cell nine-mark box, whose unequal arm-survival probabilities prevent transferring those results to the common-survival class.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery expanded the original nine-mark landmark benchmark into class-wide rate and endpoint results, censor-aware Gaussian and Poisson lower benchmarks, and certified benchmark intervals. The final math review passed without findings after correcting the additive coverage-repair charge and verifying all seven cited sources. The novelty referee graded the delivered package incremental below the field floor because sharp class-wide constants, full finite-intensity experiment/value convergence, and uniformly optimal original-record attainment remain open; formalization was not started.
tldr: Honest causal landmark intervals compare each intervention's own survivor cumulative incidence. The proved results give an exactly honest original-record rate bracket with exponent \((1-\gamma)/2\), the zero-information endpoint \(0.9\Omega_G\), and a lawful rare-baseline face retaining unknown propensity in finite Poisson counts. A one-stratum censor-aware converse strengthens the finite-sample floor, gives a local Gaussian lower constant, and supplies a certified four-count Poisson lower benchmark. The sharp full-class Gaussian constant, complete face-uniform finite-intensity experiment, value convergence, and class-wide certified optimal attainment remain open. The separate positive-cell nine-mark benchmark has proved likelihood, transfer, and computation results; its unequal-survival box is not the class at one common intensity.
gap: Regular competing-risk Gaussian expansions and generic confidence-game optimization do not supply a uniform survivor-normalized minimax phase diagram over zero event and censor faces, learned nuisance laws, and arbitrary scheduled ties.
fill: The phase-diagram question links unknown-censoring efficient precision, a finite-intensity marked confidence game, and the data-free endpoint using complete original records. A positive-cell nine-mark instance supplies audited checks without serving as a positivity-only theorem.
